{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales.head()

# Show column names and data types
dtypes = sales.dtypes

# Check for missing values
missing = sales.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in key columns
loyalty_status_unique = sales['loyalty_status'].unique()
order_status_unique = sales['order_status'].unique()

# Print summary
print('Top rows:')
print(top_rows)
print('\nData types:')
print(dtypes)
print('\nMissing values:')
print(missing)
print('\nUnique loyalty statuses:')
print(loyalty_status_unique)
print('\nUnique order statuses:')
print(order_status_unique)"}
